extractor.note: Read every paragraph carrying transcend- (outside transcendental) or immanen-, in file order.

coverage_note: Term-led pass over the whole file (lines 1-467): every paragraph containing the transcendence family, including bare transcendent and immanent, was read; paragraphs without such a word were not read.

units.claim: Beside immanent perceptions that actually posit their objects there are transcendently directed positing perceptions, the outer perceptions.
units.quote: Alongside these there are also transcendently directed perceptions of the same being-positing character—the so-called outer perceptions.

units.claim: Being is either immanent, as closed experience or noematic correlate, or transcendent, whose transcendence lies in the infinity of the noematic correlate required as its matter.
units.quote: In one case, being is “immanent”—being as a closed experience or noematic experience-correlate; in the other, transcendent being, whose “transcendence” lies in the infinity of the noematic correlate required as its being-“matter.”

units.claim: Where giving intuition is transcending, adequate givenness is impossible and only the Idea of the objectuality with an a priori rule for inadequate experiences can be given.
units.quote: Where the giving intuition is transcending, adequate givenness is impossible; only the Idea of such an objectuality can be given, together with an a priori rule for the lawful infinities of inadequate experiences.

absences.expected_because: The constitution problem of the regions follows §144, which divided being into the immanent and the transcendent given only as an Idea.
